references.text: God saw that Leah was hated, so he opened her womb, while Rachel was barren.
God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and opened her womb.
The angel of the Lord said to her: 'See, you are with child and shall bear a son, and you shall call him Ishmael, for the Lord has heard your affliction.'
Then Rachel said: 'God has judged in my favor. He has also heard my voice and given me a son.'
Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord, the fruit of the womb is a reward.
Both verses emphasize that Leah's fertility is a direct response to God's attention and mercy.
